mem-001.summary: Go for daemon (single binary), Python for AI logic (flexibility)

mem-002.summary: Executor builds prompt with 'Start my Navigator session' prefix for Claude Code

mem-003.summary: pilot test was dry-run only, replacing with pilot task for real execution

mem-004.summary: CRITICAL: Navigator integration in executor prompt is THE CORE VALUE of Pilot. When refactoring BuildPrompt(), ALWAYS preserve 'Start my Navigator session' prefix. This was accidentally removed during 'simplification' - broke the entire system. Pilot without Navigator = just another Claude Code wrapper with no value.
mem-004.incident: 2026-01-26: Refactored buildPrompt to 'simplify', accidentally removed Navigator. User caught it after deployment.

mem-005.summary: BuildPrompt checks for .agent/ folder to conditionally add Navigator session start. This auto-detects Navigator-enabled projects.

mem-006.summary: Navigator prompt should use 'Run until done' to trigger Loop Mode. Navigator then handles WORKFLOW CHECK, phase transitions (RESEARCH→PLAN→IMPL→VERIFY→COMPLETE), and EXIT_SIGNAL for completion.

mem-007.summary: Pilot can detect Navigator progress by parsing: 'Phase:', 'Progress:', 'EXIT_SIGNAL: true', 'Mode: LOOP/TASK'. These appear in Claude Code stdout when Navigator is active.

mem-008.summary: Task status drift: Pilot updates individual task files (TASK-XX.md) but NOT DEVELOPMENT-README.md index. Causes confusion where task files show complete but index shows planned. TASK-32 created to auto-sync.
mem-008.incident: 2026-01-27: TASK-05, TASK-12-16 all showed complete in task files but planned in index.

mem-009.summary: Logging with Info level goes to stdout and breaks CLI UX (banner display). Use Debug level for operational logs in interactive commands like 'pilot telegram'.

mem-010.summary: For development builds: 'brew uninstall pilot && brew install --HEAD pilot'. The --HEAD flag builds from main branch. Regular 'brew install' uses pinned tag in formula.

mem-011.summary: CRITICAL: syncMainBranch() uses git reset --hard origin/main after every task. When GitHub push propagation lags behind the immediately-following fetch+reset, local commits are silently destroyed (only reflog-recoverable, 90d window). Race is in remote propagation, not push failure — reordering does NOT fix it. Fix: replace with merge --ff-only. Two call sites: runner.go:3258 (config-gated) and epic.go:1498 (NOT gated).
mem-011.incident: 2026-05-20: gitnation-companion-pilot workshop demo. Two Pilot commits wiped from local main. TASK-283 / GH-3018.

mem-012.summary: MetricsQuery.Projects []string is the established WHERE project_path IN (?) idiom for executions table; reuse, don't invent new filter shapes

mem-013.summary: pilot start -p scopes execution + git-graph only; dashboard cards, sparklines, recent executions, in-flight tasks mix all projects; in-memory metricsCard increments drift up to 5s before storeRefreshCmd corrects

mem-014.summary: TASK-284 design: always-on scope when -p set (no opt-out flag); gateway HTTP inherits daemon scope (no ?project= param); eval panel gets [global] label (schema migration deferred to TASK-285); in-memory callback drift accepted as eventual consistency

mem-015.summary: Self-test command must match the binary's real CLI contract: the pre-exec smoke test ran 'pilot --version' (a flag pilot doesn't register -> exit 1) instead of the 'version' subcommand, blocking every hot upgrade. Arg-agnostic test fakes hid it. File: bug_smoke_test_wrong_cli_contract.md (GH-3222/#3223).

mem-016.summary: macOS codesign error swallowed in upgrade.go PrepareForExecution (`_ =`), producing an unsigned binary Gatekeeper refuses to syscall.Exec -> silent hot-upgrade failure. File: bug_hot_upgrade_silent_codesign.md (TASK-303).

mem-017.summary: TUI rendered 'Now running X - Restarting...' / 'Installing 100%' without surfacing upgradeMessage, hiding hot-upgrade failures behind a success-looking panel. File: bug_hot_upgrade_restarting_ui_trap.md (TASK-303).

mem-018.summary: AUP/cyber-safeguard kills security-audit model output mid-run, but Workflow tool persists findings to /tmp/claude-501/.../<wfId>.output — recover via jq, never re-summarize via the model. File: learning_audit_safeguard_bypass.md (TASK-322).

mem-019.summary: Dashboard QUEUE shows shipped work as 'failed' when SelfHealExecutionAfterMerge is mis-scoped. executions.project_path stores an ABSOLUTE FS PATH, not owner/repo (D3/#3354 regression matched 0 rows). Also: the merged-PR scan never self-healed and parent epics weren't healed. Fixed v2.166.4/#3363. File: learning_selfheal_projectpath_discriminator.md (TASK-352).

mem-020.summary: Releasing Pilot: autopilot auto-cuts releases only on pilot/GH-* merges, so a manual fix/* PR sits on main unreleased. Manual release = push a v* tag (release.yml GoReleaser → Homebrew); do NOT also `make release`. Daemon runs ~/.local/bin/pilot (not make-install ~/go/bin, not brew) — update via `pilot upgrade`. Version string lags the commit; check `go version -m <bin> | grep vcs.revision`. File: learning_pilot_release_and_binary_path.md.

mem-021.summary: Making a client method paginate (per_page+page until short page) silently breaks fixed-list httptest mocks that return the full list per request — they loop to maxPages (N×pages items) and starve callers, hanging tests to the 600s package timeout. C6/#3369 did this to the stress mocks. Fix: mocks return [] for page>=2, and ALWAYS bound test busy-waits with a deadline. A 600s 'FAIL <pkg>' with no '--- FAIL: Test' = a hang, not an assertion. File: learning_paginated_client_breaks_fixedlist_mocks.md (TASK-353).

mem-022.summary: Release pipeline is tag-only — goreleaser (release.yml) is the SOLE publisher. As of #3377 (after v2.166.6) `make release` only pushes the version tag; it no longer does a local `gh release create`, which had 422-collided with goreleaser and made it skip the Homebrew formula publish (bit v2.149.4 and v2.166.6). Never publish assets before goreleaser. File: decision_release_pipeline_tag_only.md.

mem-023.summary: Epic auto-decomposition could silently discard a child's completed work and record a false 'completed' no-op against a foreign base SHA. Parent epic runs in an empty orchestrator worktree; a child that commits real work but produces no PR has that work discarded on worktree cleanup. Fixed PR #3383 (TASK-356): ExecuteSubIssues fails loud on commits-without-PR; runner.go harvests epic CommitSHA only after the no-commits guard. The no-decompose label is the reliable escape hatch.
mem-023.incident: 2026-06-01: studio-sdk #16 epic spawned child #17 which committed ~7 files over 26 min; child closed unmerged, branch never pushed, parent recorded completed+foreign-SHA no-op. 26 min of work lost.

mem-024.summary: Dashboard QUEUE 'failed' count inflated (784 vs 234 real): dispatcher collapsed every non-success outcome (declined/no-op/stalled/budget/infra/rate-limit/skipped) into status='failed'. Fix: TerminalStatus() classifier + distinct statuses + idempotent reclassifyLegacyOutcomes() backfill + widened heal-on-merge. Plus a TUI truncateVisual ANSI bug that blanked the styled failed line when the breakdown suffix overflowed the mini-card (fixed v2.166.11).

mem-025.summary: 'Restart != rebuild': a daemon restart picks up new code only if the binary was rebuilt from updated source AND the process started after that build. Stale ~/.local/bin/pilot (built from un-pulled root main, pre-fix) showed old data through 3 restarts. Verify via pilot version + ps start-time vs binary mtime + query the store directly; a startup-gated backfill can be applied as SQL directly (with backup) if the daemon is stale.

mem-026.summary: The Pilot daemon's *finalization* path (push -> PR-create -> label) is the active reliability bottleneck — the *execution* path (Claude Code subprocess) is reliable. Studio-sdk extraction (PRs #28-#56, 2026-06-02/-03): 9/10 connectors shipped, but ~7/12 finalization runs needed manual recovery (Shape A stall-before-push), 2 hit a retry-race vs human recovery PRs (Shape B), 1 late-duplicate-PR (Shape C). The harness + review gates carried the outcome, not daemon finalization reliability. `no-decompose` label routes through the direct path (fatal error handling) instead of the epic path (warn-only) and was empirically reliable. Canonical fix: TASK-359 (3-layer plan: unified finalizeExecution MANUAL + 4 no-decompose Pilot issues for boundary fixes).

mem-027.summary: TASK-359 Layer 1 (unified epic finalization error contract) SHIPPED in v2.166.16 (PR #3441, merged 2026-06-04 11:46 CET). Closes the boundary layers of the finalization-bottleneck (mem-026). New Runner.finalizeEpicBranchPR matches the direct-path ordering (guard -> push -> harvest -> idempotency -> CreatePR -> invariant); push/PR-create failures now mark Success=false (was log.Warn+continue, root cause of Shape A ~70% failure mode); pre-create FindMergedPRByBranch short-circuit (Shape C); atomic MarkExecutionCompleted in store.go. Smoke green (full short test + lint + new unit tests). Live Shape A/B/C verification deferred to the next SDK extraction batch (github -> linear -> jira -> asana) -- the SDK work IS the verification. Original spec Step 7 (tighten HasCompletedExecution) was REFUTED -- would break direct-commit rows + TestTaskCompletionInvariant.
